title: Status counts load every matching media row
reasoning: GET /status is a dashboard-style endpoint, but it materializes full MediaItem ORM rows for each status just to compute counts. On a large media library this does unnecessary row hydration and memory allocation, and the endpoint can become slow or memory-heavy even though the database can answer these as aggregate counts.
recommendation: Use aggregate count queries such as select(func.count()).select_from(MediaItem).where(MediaItem.status == ...) for the four counters, while keeping a separate limited query for the current processing item details.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided for this route, and there is no evidence of a large-dataset performance assertion around /status.
suggestedRegressionTest: Seed many MediaItem rows across statuses and assert /status returns correct counts without selecting full MediaItem rows, for example by checking generated SQL or using a repository/helper that issues count queries.
minimumFixScope: Limit the change to get_media_status count query construction in app/api/media.py.
